relation: Exact internal-radius contract on SUPPLIED maps: B : H -> {set G} satisfies upstream minor_rmap on the same map, a supplied centre map ctr : H -> G has ctr x in B x as a separate clause, and every vertex of B x is reached from ctr x by a walk of at most r edges (size p) whose listed vertices all lie inside B x. Standalone internal_ball_in is vacuous on an empty set and does not assert centre membership. Same-map adapter: minor_rmap plus centres and balls <-> centres, balls, pairwise disjointness and edge realization. Host/pattern/radius order unchanged; no graph_dist, truncation, ambient radius, inducedness or covering condition.
summary: C18 migrates exactly the two X220 internal-radius helpers. The canonical keeps the supplied branch map B and centre map ctr, reuses upstream minor_rmap on the same B, keeps centre membership as a separate clause and keeps the internal ball: walks of at most r edges whose listed vertices stay inside the branch. A proved same-map adapter recovers the legacy clause list, so nonempty and connected branches are derived, not assumed.

Three current objects and the whole row support four iff certificates. x220_polynomial_expansion keeps one polynomial for the whole class and every depth r; the row keeps the class quantifier and one uniform twin-width bound d. There are no prior frozen mentions, so no Original is needed; the row stays open with its doc block and legs unchanged.

The public-only client covers empty-set vacuity with a separate centre, zero radius (singleton balls, radius zero exactly the subgraphs, K3 an internal 1-shallow but not 0-shallow minor of KB 2 2), empty pattern, impossible nonempty pattern in the empty host, and a disconnected branch that fails at every radius although the truncated graph_dist of its induced subgraph accepts every pair.
